Riiffs Freeze Extrait de Parfum 100 ml – An intense, fresh and masculine fragrance full of energy and modern elegance

For: Men 
Brand: Riiffs
Content: 100 ml
Concentration: Perfume Extract
Fragrance category: Fresh · Aromatic · Woody · Masculine

Description:

Riiffs Freeze Extrait de Parfum 100 ml is a powerful, invigorating men's fragrance that perfectly combines freshness and intensity. The high concentration of Extrait de Parfum ensures exceptional longevity and a striking fragrance presence.

The fragrance opens with icy-fresh, sparkling notes that immediately create a dynamic and energetic impression. Aromatic accords unfold at its heart, lending the scent depth, character, and masculine elegance. The base of warm woods, musk, and amber nuances provides a sensual, long-lasting finish with modern sophistication.

Fragrance composition:

Top note: Fresh, cool citrus and mint accords
Heart note: Aromatic notes, spicy nuances
Base note: Woods, musk, amber

Characteristics:

  • An intense, fresh men's fragrance with a modern appeal.

  • Extrait de Parfum for extra long shelf life

  • Ideal for everyday use, the office, or special occasions

  • Masculine, self-confident and dynamic

  • Perfect for men who want to combine freshness with depth.

Riiffs Freeze Extrait de Parfum 100 ml – An icy-fresh fragrance that uniquely embodies strength, elegance and modern masculinity.
